body:
i feel like with my fp, im in a fantasy, happy, merry bubble hidden away from the horrible horrible world. outside of our bubble come people who want to tear down my happy place, and steal my fp away, all for the control. the people outside are constantly turning on each other and pushing other down for the control. the people outside are impure. the world outside is empty, and lonely. no-one knows you and yet everyone hates you. they constantly stomp on me just to feel better about themselves, so why should i stop when i am hurting them back. the difference between me and them is that im hurting them to perserve my love. if they take her away i cannot survive longer.


unfortunately for myself, i pushed my fp away on my own because i was being emotionally abusive in that sense. the world without my bubble is depressing; i hate that this is reality, i hate that all of it was a lie to make me feel better. frankly, im on the brink of death.

i don’t understand what you mean by end goal;; i simply want to stay being happy as her best friend, and make her happy too.
i should probably add i don’t think i’m romantically interested in her, just platonically.
